# Kyrus ERP – AI Coding Instructions

## Big picture
- Backend is FastAPI + SQLModel + Alembic + PostgreSQL under app/; API routers live in app/api/v1 and are mounted with prefix /api/v1 in app/main.py.
- Frontend is React + TypeScript + Vite in kyrus-web; production build goes to kyrus-web/dist and is served by the backend’s SPA catch‑all in app/main.py.
- There is a legacy static frontend in frontend/; its API config is generated by scripts/generate_frontend_config.py (do not hand‑edit frontend/js/config.js).

## Key files and patterns
- app/main.py: app creation, CORS, health/root endpoints, /static mount, and SPA fallback for built frontend.
- app/core/config.py: env‑driven settings (PROJECT_NAME, DB, CORS, JWT); always read from .env (see .env.example).
- app/api/v1/api.py: central router registry; new endpoints must be imported and included here.
- app/models + app/schemas + app/crud + app/services: model/schema/CRUD/service layering; keep changes consistent across these layers.
- alembic/env.py: imports every model class so autogenerate sees tables; add new models here before running migrations.

## Developer workflows (local)
- Backend dev: python -m venv venv && source venv/bin/activate && pip install -r requirements.txt; run with uvicorn app.main:app --reload.
- Full stack orchestrator: python run.py (starts backend + Vite frontend).
- Docker: docker compose up -d (DB + services); docker compose logs -f db for DB logs.
- Frontend build: cd kyrus-web && npm install && npm run build (required for backend SPA serving).
- Env generation: python scripts/generate_env.py (creates .env with SECRET_KEY and ports).

## Integration points
- API base URL is /api/v1; frontend uses VITE_API_URL (see kyrus-web/Dockerfile and Vite envs).
- Static uploads served from /static via app/main.py.
- Auth uses JWT and bcrypt (see app/core/security.py).
